fundamental_action_reconstruction/STRICT_EQUATION_SHEET_KERNEL_TO_LTOTAL_CURRENT.md:1821:`P2533/S1483` compresses the P2531/P2532 four-key ternary table into exact generating polynomials. Coefficient extraction reproduces class counts `1/15/65`, theorem-deficit counts `1,8,24,32,16`, axiom-upgrade counts `4,6,4,1`, absent-source-gap counts `32,24,8,1`, and derivative edge counts `108/108`.
